title: Miftah tutorial 15 · Manage rent cheques end to end
description:
Follow rent cheques through collection: see what is due and overdue, scan a cheque photo onto its contract, bank a batch, clear a cheque, and record a returned cheque and its replacement.

Who this is for: Company Admin, Property Manager.

Chapters:
0:00 Due and Overdue
0:23 Scan the Cheque
0:52 Bank a Batch
1:11 Clear When the Bank Confirms
1:28 A Cheque Comes Back
1:45 Replace It
2:08 On the Contract

Part of the Miftah web course — playlist: Miftah · Collections

تابع شيكات الإيجار خلال التحصيل: اطّلع على المستحق والمتأخر، وامسح صورة الشيك ضوئيًا وأرفقها بعقده، وأودع دفعة في البنك، وصرّف الشيك، وسجّل الشيك المرتجع وبديله.
